public_body: Fall River Redevelopment Authority Preliminary Screening Committee
overall: The AG found the Committee violated the OML by failing to post notice for its August 30, 2018 meeting. The Committee had already ratified those actions at a duly noticed September 19, 2018 meeting, so no further relief was required.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee posted no notice for its August 30, 2018 meeting, its first meeting after formation.
allegations.key_passage: find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to post notice for its August 30, 2018, meeting.
